summary: Frontend-only UI testing for Stock Management System UI improvements (Sl No, Export rename, Excel-style sort/filter, Totals row at top, Refresh buttons). All 11 listed scenarios verified end-to-end on the live preview URL with admin login. All targeted data-testids resolve and behave correctly. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: StockBalancePage.jsx is 437 lines and ColumnFilter is duplicated logic vs DataTable.jsx ColumnHeader; consider unifying both to a single reusable component to follow DRY and ease maintenance.

StockInPage.jsx (~570+ lines), StockOutPage.jsx, StockTransferPage.jsx — each contains multiple list components plus modals. Files exceed 700-line guideline; recommend splitting *List components into separate files (e.g., ReceiptNoteList.jsx, IssueNoteList.jsx).
Sl No is computed via filteredRows.indexOf(r)+1 inside a column value() lambda — O(n^2) per render; fine for current data sizes but should be precomputed if list grows.
Stock Summary totals row uses sticky top-0 inside an overflow-x-auto container; works but verify vertical sticky behavior when table is tall enough to scroll inside its container.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stock Summary route is /balance (not /stock-balance). Login at /login, then nav via sidebar 'Stock Summary'. Key testids verified: users-export-button, low-stock-export-button, transactions-export-button (all show 'Export' text); totals-row, totals-total_quantity, totals-reorder_level, filter-trigger-{label-kebab}, sort-asc, sort-desc on StockBalancePage; rn-export-button/rn-refresh-button, rkn-export-button/rkn-refresh-button, in-export-button/in-refresh-button, pn-export-button/pn-refresh-button, str-export-button/str-refresh-button, stn-export-button/stn-refresh-button on Stock In/Out/Transfer list views. Each list table uses ColumnHeader (data-testid='{testid}-sort' and '{testid}-filter') from DataTable.jsx. Verified: (1) Export downloads correctly named xlsx files, (2) Refresh triggers /api/<resource> request, (3) Stock Summary totals row IS the first <tr> in <tbody> (data-testid first-tbody-row == 'totals-row'), (4) totals update when filter applied (664 → 20 after filtering Godown), (5) Numeric columns show 'Smallest → Largest' label and text columns show 'A → Z'. Existing functionality (filter-all/in/out tabs in Transactions, Receipt/Racking/Issue/Picking/Transfer-Request/Transfer-Note sub-tabs) continues to load.
